notes.title: The 1.2.0 Update is out with the Tranquiliser fix.
notes.content:
We just pushed the new update out! The issue with the tranquliser has been fixed. Thanks a lot for the feedback and your continued support.


Our team is working hard on version 1.3.0 which will have the level editor and steam workshop integration. If you guys have more suggestion then please let us know.
